title: The Librarians
description:
S04 E03 — And the Christmas Thief
Santa takes Flynn, Baird and Jenkins on his first vacation in centuries; the Librarians use Santa's sleigh to save Ezekiel's career-criminal mother, as well as Christmas itself, from Santa's grinch of a brother, the Patron Saint of Thieves.

title: The Librarians
description:
S04 E04 — And the Silver Screen
Drawn into the world of Baird's favorite film noir movie, the Librarians must perfect their skills in lassoing, sharpshooting and snappy dialogue to make it out alive.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S01 E03 — The Rollin' on the River Job
The Leverage team takes on a greedy riverboat casino owner, before he can bulldoze the homes of longtime New Orleans natives for his planned expansion.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S01 E04 — The Tower Job
One member of the team seeks redemption and justice by convincing Leverage to con a developer out of an entire luxury apartment building.

title: The Librarians: The Next Chapter
description:
S01 E01 — And the Deadly Drekavac
When a Librarian from 200 years ago reappears today, he brings back to life a long-closed magical library and accidentally resurrects an evil Drekavac.

title: The Librarians: The Next Chapter
description:
S01 E02 — And the Dance of Doom
Newly assembled Librarians crew investigates a mysterious dancing sickness, leading them to a showdown with a powerful magical factioneer at a professional ballet company.

title: 2nd Serve
description: Fired from an affluent country club, a washed-up tennis star takes a job at a public racquet club. He trains a ragtag team of oddballs to play against a team of his former co-workers to get back at his rivals.

title: The Librarian: Return to King Solomon's Mines
description: An adventurer (Noah Wyle) and a brilliant archaeologist (Gabrielle Anwar) use a map to search for the fabled mines of King Solomon.

title: The Librarians
description:
S03 E09 — And the Fatal Separation
The balance of the universe is put in jeopardy when the Monkey King's sacred homeland of Shangri-La is taken over by a ruthless collector of magical artifacts.

title: The Librarians
description:
S03 E10 — And the Wrath of Chaos
The library is simultaneously infiltrated by DOSA and Apep; Flynn, Baird, Stone, Cassandra, Ezekiel and Jenkins must put aside their differences to save the library, the world and themselves.

title: The Librarians
description:
S04 E01 — And the Dark Secret
A secret sect of the Vatican Church unearths a map detailing the locations of the four cornerstones of the Library of Alexandria; Flynn and the Librarians work with an unexpected ally to stop them before the stones can be used to destroy the Library.

title: The Librarians
description:
S04 E02 — And the Steal of Fortune
When people begin getting hurt in the unluckiest of ways, the Librarians follow the trail to a casino where the owner appears to possess an artifact capable of stealing people's luck.

description:

description:
S04 E04 — And the Silver Screen
Drawn into the world of Baird's favorite film noir movie, the Librarians must perfect their skills in lassoing, sharpshooting and snappy dialogue to make it out alive.

title: The Librarians
description:
S04 E05 — And the Bleeding Crown
Flynn is excited to team up with his Librarian hero, Darrington Dare, to take down an ancient and powerful enemy let loose in the modern day; Darrington leaves the Librarians with a dire warning that there can only be one Librarian.

title: The Librarians
description:
S04 E06 — And the Grave of Time
When Baird goes after Nicole Noone in an attempt to repair her rift with the Library, she winds up joining Nicole on a mission to retrieve a dangerous artifact before it falls into the hands of Russian grave robbers.

title: The Librarians
description:
S04 E07 — And the Disenchanted Forest
When dissension threatens the group, Baird takes the Librarians to a charismatic self-help guru's team-building camp on the edge of a forest where people have been mysteriously disappearing.

title: The Librarians
description:
S04 E08 — And the Hidden Sanctuary
Cassandra decides to take a vacation after she freezes up during a mission; during her visit to Havenport, labeled the "Safest Town in America," Cassandra believes things may not be as ideal as they seem.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E04 — The Fairy Godparents Job
A clinic is forced to close because its funds were lost in a Ponzi scheme; the team goes after a corrupt investment banker who has money hidden from the authorities.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E05 — The Three Days of the Hunter Job
A TV host claims a school-bus driver caused an accident that left two children dead; Sophie takes the lead as the team sets out to put the host in her place.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E06 — The Top Hat Job
The team tries to infiltrate a corporation responsible for putting tainted food on the market.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E07 — The Two Live Crew Job
The team must go up against a crew of thieves in order to retrieve a priceless artwork.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E08 — The Ice Man Job
Hardison acts as the inside man when the team goes after an unscrupulous diamond merchant.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E09 — The Lost Heir Job
The team tries to stop a corrupt lawyer from taking over his client's estate.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E10 — The Runway Job
The team infiltrates the fashion world to take down a sweatshop owner.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E11 — The Bottle Job
The team runs a high-tech version of a classic con in order to save a bar from a loan shark.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E12 — The Zanzibar Marketplace Job
The team has to work with Sterling to free Maggie from a Ukrainian jail.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E13 — The Future Job
A con man masquerades as a psychic medium in order to steal money from his clients.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E14 — The Three Strikes Job
The team runs into an unexpected complication while trying to take down a corrupt mayor.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E15 — The Maltese Falcon Job
Surrounded by FBI and with Sterling hot on their heels, the team decides to hide in plain sight, while continuing to take down the corrupt mayor and his gunrunning partner; Nate has a different endgame in mind for them all.

title: Leverage
description:
S03 E01 — The Jailhouse Job
In order to save the life of an innocent inmate, Nate must bring down the corrupt warden of the prison where he is incarcerated and escape.

title: Leverage
description:
S03 E02 — The Reunion Job
The team infiltrates the high school reunion of a software magnate who is involved with the Axis of Evil.

title: Leverage
description:
S03 E03 — The Inside Job
When Parker is trapped in an unknown location while working a theft for her mentor, the team must race the clock to find and free her.

title: Leverage
description:
S03 E04 — The Scheherazade Job
In order to rob a Boston vault, the team must time their heist to a nearby symphony concert.

title: Leverage
description:
S03 E05 — The Double Blind Job
Nate and the team try to take down a corrupt CEO before he can release a drug that will kill thousands.

title: Leverage
description:
S03 E06 — The Studio Job
In order to take down a corrupt record executive, the team must infiltrate the world of country and western music.

title: Leverage
description:
S03 E07 — The Gone Fishin' Job
After targeting a greedy debt collector, the crew discovers that their target is also a domestic terrorist who is funding an armed militia.

title: Leverage
description:
S03 E08 — The Boost Job
The team enters the world of master car thieves in order to take down a crooked car dealer.

title: Leverage
description:
S03 E09 — The Three-Card Monte Job
When small businessmen are blackmailed into committing crimes, the team's investigation reveals an unlikely foe.

title: Leverage
description:
S03 E10 — The Underground Job
In the aftermath of a deadly mine explosion, the team infiltrates the coal mines of West Virginia to stop the dangerous practices of the mine's owner.

title: Leverage
description:
S03 E11 — The Rashomon Job
The team realizes that they each tried to steal the same artifact on the same night five years ago.

title: Leverage
description:
S03 E12 — The King George Job
The team discovers that an antiquities trafficker is using refugee children to smuggle artifacts; Sophie confronts the consequences of her past.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S01 E05 — The Paranormal Hacktivity Job
When a woman believes she is being haunted, Sophie leads Breanna and Parker through a con to convince the two real estate scammers responsible to target Leverage HQ.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S01 E06 — The Card Game Job
The Leverage team dives into the world of a fantasy collectible card game with a devoted following to take down a pharmaceutical bad boy who is price-gouging drugs.

title: Almost Paradise
description:
S02 E09 — Old Times
When Alex entangles himself in a homicide investigation on behalf of his love interest, Ann Villegas, he is forced to befriend a geriatric couple with peculiar personality traits.

title: Almost Paradise
description:
S02 E10 — Brigade
Alex goes undercover as a prisoner and, with the help of Kai and Ernesto, figures out how The Waterboarder has been running his criminal empire from behind bars.

title: The Ark
description:
S01 E07 — A Slow Death is Worse
The crew discover they're not alone in space and learn more about where they came from.

title: The Ark
description:
S01 E08 — Every Single Person Matters
A new polarizing figure enters the equation as the crew suffers technical difficulties.

title: The Librarians: The Next Chapter
description:
S01 E03 — And the Ghost Train
Half of the Librarian team gets trapped on a runaway ghost train; can the rest of the team help in solving the unresolved business of the ghosts on board before the train completes a rampage of destruction?

title: The Librarians: The Next Chapter
description:
S01 E04 — And the Thief of Love
The Librarians head to Paris after a string of robberies leaves mysteriously lovestruck victims in their wake; when they learn that a magical love artifact is behind the thefts, they enlist help from Vikram's old friend, Cupid himself.
